name: Architect on Call — CCA-F Exam Prep
author: Eugenia Wang
affiliation: Independent and unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
audience: solution architects preparing for the Claude Certified Architect - Foundations exam
goal: Prepare for the CCA-F exam by building understanding of 7 root principles across all domains, through hands-on sessions, 72% phase gates, and a 4-of-6 timed practice mock. Self-contained, project-local, delivered in Claude Code.

structure.final_mock: 4 of the 6 official scenarios, picked at random, 72% pass
structure.running_example: MY_SYSTEM.md (the learner's own Claude system; capstone = its architecture brief)

model_guidance: Sonnet recommended. Static reference/ aids need no model. Haiku is fine for light review (definitions, recall, navigation, the static drills); judgment-heavy parts (grading scenarios, mock, remediation) are better on Sonnet. Opus unnecessary.

canonical_files.lessons_dir: lessons/ (one file per session; loaded individually for low token use)
canonical_files.static_study_aids: reference/ (principle-map.html card + distractor-gauntlet.html interactive quiz; no model needed)

working_state_files.note: copied from templates/ to the course root on first-run setup

completion_tracking.completion_rule: course_completed=true only after all phase gates AND the final 4-of-6 mock are cleared at >=72%, with MY_SYSTEM.md architecture brief finished

legacy_note: Earlier files (session-guides/, workbooks/, labs/, learner/, CHECKPOINTS.md, COMPETENCY-CHECKS.md, REVIEW-SYSTEM.md, study/OFFICIAL-EXAM-ANCHORS.md, study/SKILLS-MATRIX.md, study/DOMAIN-MAP.md, study/SCENARIOS.md, and the legacy maintainer scripts/) are superseded by the canonical files above and retained as reference only.
